jobs.description:
As a Director of German Data Centre Operations, you will be responsible for:

• Providing leadership, direction and strategy across our German territory.

• Building and leading a new DCO organization in Germany.

• Working with geographically distributed teams and contributing to the success of his/her organization and other related teams.

• Coaching and mentoring managers and individual contributors across the organization.

• Growing the team by recruiting and retaining top talent.

• Delivering large-scale projects on-time with high quality.

• Collaborating and working effectively with various teams across the organization at both a technical level and a business level.

• Ensuring all sites are delivered to a standardized, high-quality bar, and this quality is sustained, day on day, week on week, year on year.

• Holding others to account as needed to ensure we meet our quality & delivery goals.

• Defining and contributing to global objectives to move the organization forwards.

As a Director of German Data Centre Operations, you will lead the region and be responsible for the overall availability of Oracle’s Cloud Infrastructure. You should be able to dive deep into any part of the stack and higher-level system interactions. You should value simplicity and scale, work comfortably in a collaborative, agile environment, and be excited to learn. You should have a demonstrated track record working in the industry, already having worked at hyperscale in previous positions. You should be fully versed in Data Centre build, live operations management, change control and be familiar with LEAN and 5S. Detailed Description and Job Requirements Working with world-class global teams to implement and support cutting-edge Oracle technology in Cloud Data Centres requires an experienced manager with a proven ability to lead from the front who can thrive in a complex matrix environment. To maximize the quality of delivery and reliability of our sites you will:

• Work across multiple LOB effectively, negotiating and bringing together stakeholders & teams to ensure success for Oracle.

• Negotiating and working with local vendors to deliver a strategy to drive performance and meet quality expectations. This encompasses LV cabling vendors through to Colocation partners.

• Work closely with Human Resources within the regions to ensure the best possible relationship and care for your Oracle employees.

• Focus and prioritize appropriately on what is most important to Oracle at any given time as priorities can shift quickly.

• Drive scalability practices to ensure efficiencies across your organization and space. Project work will also be a crucial part of the engagement, you will also:

• Lead the implementation of multi-functional projects and/or systems.

• Manage scope, expectations, implementation approach, deliverables and acceptance testing criteria, whilst appropriately managing risk.

• Driving the delivery of improvements. Interacting across functional areas to ensure objectives are met.

• Driving the development of short, medium, and long-term plans and regularly interacting across functional areas with executives to achieve strategic objectives.

• Demonstrate a track record of influencing thinking and gaining acceptance of others in sensitive situations.

• Be proactive at all times, resolving issues before they become critical.

• Work independently without escalation or supervision.

• Manage upwards effectively to VP level, with succinct, clear communication, and a solution-first approach.

• Manage individual contributors where you do not have direct authority over them.

• Resolve conflicts without escalation, by negotiation, understanding and mediating as necessary.

• Lead by example at all times.

• Be fully versed in managing risk (both project delivery and infrastructure management).

• Be able to devise plans, and strategies, bringing others on the journey with you.

• Be continuously learning about new technology advantages related to Data Centres (e.g. power density, cooling, cabling, critical load management) a SME in at least two areas. You should be able to: Candidate can expect:

• A stable environment with low turnover and great opportunities to grow.

• A merit-based organization.

• An opportunity to contribute to a well-recognized, revenue-producing Oracle product that has thousands of customers as well as be involved in cutting-edge technology

• Challenging and diverse projects.

• Competitive salary and benefits. What you need to know to be successful in this role:

• 10+ years of proven Data Centre leadership and management at hyperscale levels.

• Detailed understanding of LEAN & Six Sigma

• Demonstrated use of AI to create business value

• A deep understanding of managing resources across global teams and the local laws that can affect this.

• In-depth knowledge of the Data Center ecosystem. (cooling, electrical, networking, structured cabling, etc.)

• 5 years or more of Vendor relationship management and negotiations.

• Deep experience with distributed, highly scalable, multi-node environments.

• Written and Spoken fluency in English & German

• Strong multi-culture awareness.

• Strong HR relationship and negotiating skills at a business level to achieve objectives.

• Degree educated in a related scientific or engineering discipline.

At Oracle, we don’t just respect differences—we celebrate them. We believe that innovation starts with inclusion and to create the future we need people with diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and abilities. That’s why we’re committed to creating a workplace where all kinds of people can do their best work. It’s when everyone’s voice is heard and valued that we’re inspired to go beyond what’s been done before. https://www.oracle.com/corporate/careers/diversity-inclusion/ We expressly encourage disabled candidates to apply for this position. Please therefore feel free to voluntarily inform us in your application about any severe disability (degree of disability of at least 50%) or any equal status (degree of disability of at least 30% together with official decision on equality) in accordance with the German SGB IX.”

jobs.description:

In KWS SAAT SE & Co. KGaA Einbeck, we are looking for a  Head (m/f/d) of Software Engineering & Architecture in R&D to lead and further develop our digital engineering organization. As part of the R&D Digital Product & Technology Development leadership team you will drive the delivery of digital products, platforms, and services for R&D, while continuously improving engineering standards, delivery performance, quality, reliability, and productivity.  

You will play a key role in evolving our engineering setup into a more flexible, AI-enabled, and metric-driven organization that can respond dynamically to changing business priorities and accelerate innovation across KWS. 

Your Responsibilities 

As  Head (m/f/d) of Software Engineering & Architecture in R&D, you will shape the future of digital product delivery at KWS by building a high-performing and adaptable engineering organization that enables innovation on a scale. 

You will: 

- Lead and further develop the engineering organization responsible for delivering digital products, platforms, and services that support our global R&D activities.
- Drive engineering excellence by creating an environment where teams can deliver reliable, secure, and high-quality solutions with speed and impact.
- Build a future-ready organization by advancing modern ways of working, strengthening engineering capabilities, and unlocking the potential of AI across the development lifecycle.
- Foster strong partnerships across business and technology functions while ensuring effective collaboration with external vendors and service partners.
- Inspire, coach, and empower leaders and teams, cultivating a culture of accountability, continuous learning, innovation, and inclusion. 

Your Profile 

You are an experienced technology leader (m/f/d) who enjoys developing people, shaping organizations, and turning ambitious ideas into business value. 

You bring: 

- Proven leadership experience in software engineering, digital product development, or technology-driven organizations.
- A track record successfully leading complex products, platforms, or transformation initiatives in dynamic environments.
- Strong understanding of modern engineering practices and the ability to translate strategic goals into effective execution.
- Experience driving organizational change and building high-performing teams through trust, empowerment, and collaboration.
- Curiosity for emerging technologies, including AI, and a passion for continuously improving how engineering teams work and deliver value.
- Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with fluency in English. German is a plus. 

What You Can Expect 

In this role, you will have the opportunity to shape a strategically important engineering function at the interface of digital technology, R&D, and innovation. You will work in a global environment and contribute to strengthening the digital capabilities that support KWS’ future growth. 

You can expect: 

- A leadership role with global scope and high strategic relevance.  
- The opportunity to shape modern engineering standards, practices, and operating models  
- Highly motivated internal teams of software developers working in synthony with external teams
- A strong support to enable new technologies, like AI, and to develop future-ready digital capabilities

- A working environment that values collaboration, accountability, continuous learning, and innovation 

Join Us 

If you are excited about leading engineering transformation, enabling high-performing teams, and shaping the future of digital product delivery in an innovative R&D environment, we look forward to receiving your application. 

**Grow your career with KWS and help us build the digital capabilities of tomorrow.**

jobs.occupation: Pre-Sales Specialist Quant Valuation and Risk Solutions (m/f/d) (Vertriebsberater/in)
jobs.description:
About Infront

At Infront, we are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace, recognizing our diverse team as one of our most valuable assets. 

For 25 years, Infront has been empowering financial market experts to make faster, smarter, compliant decisions. Over time, we have expanded our foundation by bringing together companies with more than 75 years of combined market experience and trust. 

Our strength lies in market data, delivering reliable, accurate information through a powerful suite of tools, spanning Data Intelligence, Wealth Management solutions, and Trading & Investor solutions, that our users depend on every day. Today, we are one of Europe’s leading providers of market data and financial software, helping professionals navigate markets with confidence and speed. 

About the Role

We are seeking a highly motivated and commercially focused Pre-Sales Specialist to support the growth of our Infront Quant Valuation & Risk offering (IQ Risk) and our independent Valuation Services across Germany, Austria, Switzerland and Luxembourg.

Working as a trusted advisor alongside regional Sales Executives, you will engage with prospective clients throughout the sales cycle, demonstrating how our multi-asset risk analytics and independent valuation services address the complex needs of banks, asset managers, insurers, pension funds, fund administrators, AIFMs, family offices and institutional investors.

This is a quota-carrying role with co-prime responsibility for the achievement of sales targets for the in-scope Valuation & Risk product suite. Success requires a combination of strong business acumen, quantitative and financial markets expertise, regulatory knowledge, and the ability to articulate business value to both executive and operational stakeholders.

This position is based in Frankfurt am Main, where you will work closely with our quant analysts, model developers, and valuation service specialists, gaining direct access to the expertise behind IQ Risk and our independent valuation offerings.

As our Pre-Sales Specialist, you will:

- Partner with Regional Sales Executives to develop account strategies, drive revenue growth, and support commercial negotiations across assigned territories.
- Qualify client business, functional, quantitative, and technical requirements, contributing to opportunity planning, competitive positioning, and solution design.
- Deliver demonstrations, proof of concepts, valuation benchmarks, solution proposals, and technical validation activities tailored to client needs.
- Lead discovery workshops to understand valuation policies, risk measurement processes, market data requirements, and regulatory obligations.
- Design and present solution architectures, including API, data feed, and file-based integrations, that align client requirements with product capabilities.
- Act as a subject matter expert for valuation methodologies, risk analytics, and relevant regulatory frameworks, while positioning Infront Quant's independent approach against alternative solutions.
- Build trusted relationships with stakeholders across investments, risk, valuation, operations, compliance, fund accounting, and technology functions, articulating the business value and ROI of our solutions to audiences ranging from end users to executive leadership.
- Collaborate closely with Quant Analytics, Product Management, Engineering, Professional Services, and Customer Success teams, sharing market and regulatory insights to support product development, competitive positioning, and sales success.
- Travel regularly across Germany, Austria, Switzerland, and Luxembourg to support client meetings, workshops, industry events, and internal collaboration.

Who you are

- Proven experience in Pre-Sales, Solutions Consulting, or Solution Engineering supporting enterprise SaaS, financial technology, or quantitative analytics solutions.
- Strong understanding of valuation, risk analytics, capital markets, and financial instruments, ideally across fixed income, derivatives, and structured products.
- Experience supporting complex, consultative B2B sales cycles and engaging with senior business and technical stakeholders.
- Excellent presentation, demonstration, and workshop facilitation skills.
Ability to translate business, regulatory, and operational challenges into effective technology and service solutions.
- Commercially minded with experience working toward revenue targets or shared sales objectives.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence both business and technical audiences.
- Self-motivated and comfortable working across multiple countries, cultures, and stakeholder groups.
- Knowledge of valuation and risk management solutions, market data vendors, APIs, cloud technologies, quantitative risk concepts, and RFP/RFI processes is advantageous.
- Fluent German and English are essential; additional European language skills are considered a strong advantage.
- A relevant degree in Finance, Economics, Mathematics, Physics, Engineering, or a related field, as well as professional qualifications such as CFA, FRM, CAIA, or equivalent, are considered a strong advantage.

Our Offer

**Health & wellness:** Benefit from wellbeing initiatives tailored to local needs, including access to an employee assistance programme that provides confidential support to employees and their families.

**Holiday:** Enjoy competitive holiday entitlement aligned with local markets, so you can rest and recharge.

**Pension:** Plan for your long-term financial wellbeing through our pension scheme, supported by employer contributions.

**Remote work:** Enjoy the opportunity to work two days a week from home, with flexible working hours where possible. You may also request to work up to four weeks per year from a different location.

**Learning & development:** Support your career progression with access to learning resources, ongoing conversations with your manager, and opportunities to share the knowledge you gain with your team.

**Culture & impact:** Be part of an international team with a startup mindset and play a key role in making a meaningful impact.

**Our offices:** Work from Europe’s leading financial centres and be at the heart of where finance happens.

Additional notes

*Note: Since your application will be reviewed by an international team, we kindly ask that you submit your CV in English.

All candidates selected for employment are subject to pre-employment screening. This process includes professional reference and background checks conducted by our third-party partner, ZINC. These screenings are part of our commitment to ensuring a secure, compliant, and trustworthy workplace.

jobs.occupation: People & Culture Specialist - Experience & Performance (d/f/m) (Temporary Assignment) (Personalreferent/in)
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about creating exceptional employee experiences?

Do you enjoy partnering with leaders to drive talent, performance, and engagement?

Partner with the best

Baker Hughes stands as a leading global energy‑technology company, delivering innovative solutions that make energy safer, cleaner, and more efficient across the entire value chain. Operating in more than 120 countries, the company blends deep industrial expertise with advanced engineering and digital technologies to support energy production, transformation, and decarbonization. With over a century of heritage, Baker Hughes partners with customers in oil and gas, industrial sectors, and emerging energy markets to accelerate progress toward a more sustainable energy future.

Fuel your passion

The People & Culture Specialist – Experience & Performance is responsible for partnering with business leaders and employees to deliver key people initiatives across the employee lifecycle. The role provides expert support in employee relations, performance management, talent development, compensation processes, workforce planning, and organizational change. Acting as a trusted advisor, you will help drive employee engagement, inclusion, and a positive workplace culture while ensuring alignment with business objectives and local employment practices.

People & Culture in Celle offers employees the opportunity to gain experience as a P&C XP Partner for a limited period of approximately 14 months as parental leave replacement.

As a People & Culture Specialist - Experience & Performance, you will be responsible for:

- Serving as the first point of contact for employees and managers, providing P&C XP guidance and resolving complex employee relations matters.
- Supporting client groups through key P&C operating cycles, including salary planning, talent management, and performance management.
- Managing employee lifecycle movements such as promotions, salary adjustments, and workforce planning to ensure strong talent pipelines aligned with business needs.
- Contributing to M&A activities and related integration projects.
- Collaborating effectively with the works council on employee-related topics.
- Leading and championing P&C projects and employee engagement initiatives at the country level.
- Driving Diversity, Inclusion & Belonging initiatives and acting as an ambassador for the Baker Hughes culture.

To be successful in this role you will:

- Possess a bachelor’s degree from an accredited university or college (or a high school diploma/GED with relevant Human Resources experience).
- Demonstrate excellent oral and written communication skills in German and English.
- Build and maintain strong interpersonal relationships.
- Bring ability to work independently and effectively.
- Apply strong problem-solving skills to resolve complex challenges

Applications from people with disabilities are expressly welcome. Severely disabled candidates will be given preference in the case of equal qualifications.

Work in a way that works for you

We recognize that everyone is different and that the way in which people want to work and deliver at their best is different for everyone too. In this role, we can offer the following flexible working patterns:

- Working flexible hours - flexing the times when you work in the day to help you fit everything in and work when you are the most productive.
- Hybrid working - working from the Celle office three days per week to foster collaboration, partnership, and connection with colleagues.

Working with us

Our people are at the heart of what we do at Baker Hughes. We know we are better when all of our people are developed, engaged and able to bring their whole authentic selves to work. We invest in the health and well-being of our workforce, train and reward talent and develop leaders at all levels to bring out the best in each other.

Working for you

Our inventions have revolutionized energy for over a century. But to keep going forward tomorrow, we know we must push the boundaries today. We prioritize rewarding those who embrace change with a package that reflects how much we value their input. Join us, and you can expect:

- Contemporary work-life balance policies and wellbeing activities
- Comprehensive private medical care options
- Safety net of life insurance and disability programs
- Tailored financial programs
- Additional elected or voluntary benefits

Your Tasks

- Technical coordination of cybersecurity-related tasks with customer, subcontractors and internal technical disciplines
- Flow down of the security requirements to subsystem and equipment level specifications
- Ensure compliance to the security technical requirements
- Support the generation the AIT plans and operation plans
- Support preparation of satellite tests and review of test results with focus on security functions
- Define Test Specifications for Security tests and verification
- Support preparation for launch and flight phases, preparation of launcher interfaces and for operations data
- Contribute to the project risk management for risks of security nature
Your Qualifications

- Degree in engineering, physics or equivalent
- Professional experience in satellite projects, preferably in phases B/C/D
- Good conceptual and problem-solving skills
- Well-developed communication and negotiation skills
- High motivation, pro-active working approach and strong sense of responsibility
- Team-minded and ideally accustomed to work in internationally composed team
- Fluency in both spoken and written English, German language skills are highly desirable

You are interested in this position but don’t meet all the requirements or lack experience? No problem! We support you with a personalized development plan to grow into this role. Your motivation to bring things forward is of more value than your specific experience in these domains.

Your pivotal role involves managing cabin upgrade projects, ensuring seamless modification and upgrades of technical offers. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to validate service bulletin delivery dates and kit availability, assess industrial risks, and validate technical solutions with high precision. You will be the driving force in proposing and supporting new retrofit adaptations, developing upgrade solutions, and ensuring effective communication across stakeholders. This role demands structured work under deadlines, strong analytical skills, and the ability to thrive in a dynamic, pressurized environment. Join a full-time position that ensures meaningful collaboration across one of the most influential aerospace hubs in Hamburg Finkenwerder.

Your tasks:

- Establish modification and upgrades of technical offers.
- Act as the focal point for validation of contractual delivery deadlines of service bulletins and hardware kits.
- Evaluate and manage industrial risks effectively.
- Validate technical solutions and related documentation (e.g., service bulletins).
- Identify, propose, and support the development of retrofit adaptations and upgrade solutions.
- Coordinate with airlines and other stakeholders for seamless collaboration.
- Ensure workflows are structured and deadlines are met efficiently.
VORAUSSSETZUNGEN:

- A degree in aerospace engineering, technical studies, business engineering, business administration, or economics.
- 3 years of experience in interface management, supplier management, and aerospace.
- 4 years of project management experience.
- Proficiency in SAP and Google Workspace functionalities.
- Strong skills in change and risk management.
- Fluency in English (negotiation level).
- Structured and independent working style with an ability to meet deadlines.
- Capability to work under pressure while maintaining high-quality deliverables.
Benefits:

- An unlimited employment contract
- 35-hour workweek
- 30 days of annual leave
- An annual salary of around 80.000 €
- An attractive package following the Equal Pay model
